title: Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft A Scottish hacker tied to Scattered Spider was sentenced to six years in U.S. prison for a SIM-swap and phishing scheme that stole at least $11.6 million in crypto. This post Scattered Spider Hacker Gets Six Years for $11.6 Million Crypto Theft first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
